title: composer_api_random_motive request
description: Random motives: material (or the old mode) and meter are required and may be "random", drawn from the seed.

material.description: A material: a K1 id, name, key word or alias (omt.material.major, "major", "minor"), or "random", drawn from the seed. The Composer writes keys in major and natural minor. With a key that is a tonic alone it gives the mode of the key. The old member "mode" is read as before; give material or mode, not both.

mode.description: The old name of material, read as before (major, minor or random). Give material or mode, not both.

preferences.description: The settings; the motif group steers the segments strategy.

avoid.description: Motives (the motive JSON format) the result should not repeat nor resemble (API 4.3, R-673). Read only when preferences.candidates.variety is above 0.
